The DPR labels the station transitions G→C and C→P and defines G as ground/street, C as concourse, and P as platform. This three-level design standard belongs to Line 1 stations; it is not a count for the Marol Naka interchange hub across Lines 1 and 3.
Station 8 is Marol Naka. The DPR places its side platforms about 13 m above ground and describes entries/exits on both sides of Andheri-Kurla Road.

The DPR states all elevated Line 1 stations have side platforms and identifies Marol Naka as having side platforms. The two Line 1 platforms are distinct from the two Line 3 platforms at the shared interchange.
